summary: A seat whose mission run has ended is not restarted (the restart request is refused, or retired if it predates the end), a stop ends an earlier member-reconcile fault on every member, and a missing working directory is reported as such instead of as an unknown or launcher failure

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay changes. Faults are read with the subject's current stop declaration; nothing is rewritten.

compatibility.detail: POST /v1/agents/restart refuses a seat whose run has ended with 422 restart-run-ended, naming the run and how it ended. A member-reconcile fault recorded before the subject's current stop declaration no longer shows in doctor or on the agent card; a fault recorded after it still does. A start whose absolute working directory does not exist fails as `working directory ... does not exist`, and the pty launcher's own message for it classifies as working-directory-missing. Each member applies this as it upgrades; older members keep showing such faults until then.

recovery.detail: Rolling back is safe: faults before a stop show again and restarts of ended-run seats are accepted as before.
